About.title: Cared for by Eri.
About.body: Atelier Eri is a one-chair studio built around a single idea: that a manicure or a brow shaping should feel like a pause, not an errand.
About.body2: Every treatment is mapped to you — your hands, your features, your pace. No rush, no noise, just careful work in good light.
